author: svick
message: I hope that next time, you will introduce a real-world example of O(n log n). :-)

author: David
message: Like! You did explain things in understandable terms. The "greeting" analogy reminded me of the "goodbye" analogy when people leave a family gathering like a wedding and everyone needs to hug everyone else. That happens more, I think, than everyone greeting everyone, because it tends to happen at once, revealing the "algorithmic complexity" of the goodbyes, whereas the hello are spread out and the complexity isn't obvious.
